jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated production emblem for a clean comic fantasy mobile game's battle dialog, genuine transparent background. Input 1 is STYLE ONLY: crisp espresso contour, chunky readable silhouette, 2-3 hard cel-shaded value planes, warm ivory highlights, simple purposeful shapes like the approved shop item illustrations. Input 2 is SHIELD IDENTITY and icon simplicity reference only. Centered fully visible subject taking about 76% of a square canvas; generous clear alpha margin all around. Readable at 80 pixels. No text, no letters, numbers or word banners. Avoid airbrush, photoreal texture, plastic rendering, glitter, tiny engraved detail, jewelry, filigree, sparks, glow, bloom, cinematic lighting, cast shadows, ground or opaque background. Outside silhouette truly alpha zero. Balanced symmetric compact composition, no wide horizontal wings, no circular medallion frame. The shield is largest, laurels secondary, swords restrained. Happy confident practical cartoon game UI illustration.
